jobInfo.postDescription:
What You'll get to do:
Answer questions from other teams, like external, other develop team, integration team, etc.,
Answer questions from email, jira;
Monitor stage/prod status;
Maintain our deployment board;
Maintain integration list, operator configuration information, etc.,
Maintain and send the release note;
Check stage/prod status after new version has been deployed at stage/prod;
Maintain the developer documentation and ensure it is up-to-date and usable.
Requirements:
*Above 1+ years of practical experience in Web Testing.
*Solid in REST API testing.
*Functional, regression, usability, and GUI testing.
*Requirements review and analysis.
*Practical experience in Agile/Scrum development processes.
*Knowledge of bug tracking tool(s) and process (JIRA).
*Understanding web-application and browser functioning principles.
*Understanding of client-server architecture and communication principles.
*Experience with Postman/Fiddler.
*Have willing to learn new technologies.
*Excellent interpersonal skills and writing skills.
*Fluent in reading and written English
*Good spoken English is a plus.
Nice to have skills:
*Experience in Scrum and delivering working tested software in each iteration.
*Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Applied Mathematics.
*Basic knowledge of a programming language (Java, JS, Python).
*Any background related to Sports applications, Player and Transactions Management platforms, ERP applications.
*Fast learner.
